purpose: Compare shared tuple encoding with canonical concatenation against the existing frozen D and S-sum panel.
truth_access_provenance: Parent held-out truth was previously opened; this is a descriptive engineering screen.

panel.fold_normalization: Reuse the frozen leave-one-block-out normalization payloads and normalized tuple semantics.
panel.training_order: Reuse the parent raw row order and leave-one-block-out training partitions.

architecture.name: Cphi
architecture.tuple_order: Sort normalized raw tuples with the exact D lexicographic key, then apply the shared phi in that order.
architecture.relational_presentation: Concatenate four 16D phi outputs in D canonical tuple order; do not pool or sum.
architecture.activation: Parent GELU approximation after phi affine and after each of the first two readout affine layers.
architecture.optimizer: Parent SEncoder Adam update semantics, learning rate, batch size, and epoch count.

initialization.phi: Copy the existing S initializer phi tensors bit-for-bit for the matching fold and replicate.
initialization.readout: SHA-256 domain-separated per-layer seeds under F4-PRESENTATION-02-CPHI-INIT-v1, PCG64 normal draw scaled by sqrt(2/fan_in), float32 tensors; zero biases.

training_trace: per-layer gradient norm mean and maximum per epoch
instrumentation.inference_caveat: Per-fit held-out activations are diagnostic data; they do not establish a mechanism or a causal trajectory effect.

analysis.anchors: Use the existing locked D and S prediction streams without rerunning them.
analysis.primary_engineering_comparison: Cphi against frozen D and S pooled and by block/replicate.

immutability.fit_grid: 12 folds x 3 initialization replicates x Cphi
